{{Money|2,500}} every 50% health (Easy) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Spindling''' was a fast and tanky enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. Its high speed and health could make it a threat for unprepared players. ==Logbook Description== "''The Spindling is a fast-charging enemy that was created out of whim. The Narrator doesn't remember why he created the Spindling, but then again, after thousands of years one wouldn't normally be sane of mind.''" ==Appearance== The '''Spindling''' is a robot with a giant spin wheel in the place of its head. This wheel goes through its torso and has a stick and its head on it. It has a grey body, red shirt and wooden legs. It has multiple needles in its body. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Turret]] or [[Warlock]] are very useful against this. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of these towers. *As the '''Spindling''' has no immunities, all stalling towers can be used to slow it down. Examples of such towers include the [[Freezer]], [[Electroshocker]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Toxic Gunner]]. **Do note that, due to it being bigger than the average enemy, certain forms of stalling like knockback or freeze will be less effective on it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} SpindlingWalk.gif|Sprinting animation (20 December 2025 – Present) SpindlingDeath.gif|Death animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSpindling.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SpindlingIconIG.png|'''Spindling''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Spindling''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0|v1.83.0a]] **'''Spindling''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Spindling''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Extra D]]|Wave 22|Spindling|Wave 23|[[Producer]]|Wave 25}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
